items.docs:
This endpoint is used to reschedule an existing meeting by providing a new start and end time.

💡 The :meetingId path parameter should be replaced with the unique ID of the meeting you want to update.

Request Body Parameters

  • scheduledTime (required) — An object that defines the selected meeting time.

    • start_time (required) — A number repre

This endpoint cancels a previously scheduled meeting. It requires only the meeting ID in the URL path—no request body is needed.

A successful cancellation returns a 200 OK status. There is no response body.
